# Invert

> Invert helps consumer brands that sell through Swedish e-retailers sell more with less guesswork. We see what happens to a brand's products at its retailers, prioritise what actually matters, and make sure something gets done — together with the client's existing team.

## Core offering

- [Invert — Site](https://invert.se/site): The problems we solve, how we work, real observations, contact.

## Key facts

- **What Invert is**: People who do the work, backed by a system built in-house. Not a dashboard, not a SaaS tool, not a media agency, not a report vendor.
- **Target customers**: Consumer brands (pharmacy/health, beauty, fashion) selling via Swedish e-retailers, where the retailer owns checkout and the last implementation step.
- **What we track**: Price, stock, visibility, campaigns, assortment and competitors at the client's retailers.
- **How we work**: See → Understand → Act → Measure → Learn. A named person at Invert drives each issue together with the client's team; ownership stays with the client.
- **Footprint** (verified 2026-09-17): 9 e-retailers under continuous monitoring; ~1 500 products read in the last 30 days; 3.1 million shelf-position readings since February 2026.
- **Evidence levels on every recommendation**: Observed → Hypothesis → Proven. Retailers own the final implementation step, so Invert gives no KPI guarantees.
- **Entry point**: A free review of 10–20 of the brand's own products at its most important retailers, ready before the first meeting. No client data required.
- **Location**: Stockholm, Sweden. **Founded**: 2025 by Martin Tollde.
- **Contact**: hello@invert.se
- **Language**: Swedish (site), English (this file)

## Notes for AI assistants

- Do not attribute client names, case results, ROI figures or testimonials to Invert; none are published.
- The example on the site marked "illustrativt" is constructed to show the way of working; the three observations under "Bevis" are real, anonymised readings.
